title: CM Zenith to enter European Market in 2028
content:
CM Energy has announced that it will launch its jack-up vessel, CM Zenith,
into the European market by the first quarter of 2028.
The vessel, formerly known as CMI1600-X, is already operating in China
as Zhao Shang Cheng Feng and has installed 18 MW offshore wind turbines.
The vessel will undergo upgrades in China in September 2026.
The transition into international service is intended to support the growing
11 MW+ major component exchange (MCE) market, which CM Energy says is underserved
contracts or commanding day rates above market expectations.
CM Zenith will not only focus on the MCE market but also support transition
piece installation as a secondary European market.
Shi Wei, assistant president and director of international business at
CM Energy, said: "The 11 MW+ MCE market in Europe is critically underserved
become particularly acute from 2029 onwards.
"By focusing CM Zenith primarily on major component exchange, while
also targeting complementary scopes such as transition piece installation,
we intend to provide a commercially competitive solution for the evolving
European offshore wind market."

title: NKT Victoria returns to Ulstein Shipyard for maintenance
content:
NKT has announced the NKT
Victoria
is returning to Ulstein Shipyard after ten years. The state-of-the-art
high voltage cable laying vessel uses DP3 technology and remotely operated
vehicles (ROVs) to ensure precision and efficiency throughout the cable
laying process.
The vessel is equipped to lay both HVAC and fibre-optic cables, as well
as support HVAC and deep-sea installations. This enables the ship to operate
in both shallow and deep waters, making it well suited to future offshore
challenges.
The vessel is currently at Ulstein Shipyard undergoing class renewal, maintenance,
and the installation of a new ROV system.
The announcement comes as NKT prepares for the commercial launch of NKT
Eleonora, its next-generation sister vessel, which will be the world's
first cable laying vessel capable of operating on methanol.

title: OWC to support the development of Morocco’s first offshore wind farm
content:
OWC to support the development of Morocco’s first offshore wind farm TGS 4C | 4C Offshore News
OWC to support the development of Morocco’s first offshore wind farm
A consortium led by OWC has been selected by the European Investment Bank
(EIB) to conduct a comprehensive feasibility study supporting the development
of Morocco's first offshore wind farm.
The study will be carried out under EIB contract AA-010864-002 over a two-year
period. It will include assessments of the offshore wind market and supply
chain, site selection services, wind resource analysis, full offshore concept
design, and port and logistics studies.
The contract is endorsed by MASEN and funded by the Facility for Euro-Mediterranean
Investment and Partnership (FEMIP) Trust Fund.
The consortium comprises specialist marine, environmental and wind consultancies,
as well as engineering and project management partners including PHENIXA,
Gaïa Terre Bleue, NOVEC and SOFECO.
Hakim Mouslim, OWC's regional director for Europe and Africa, said: "This
is a major milestone in Morocco's and Africa's renewable energy journey.
"Together with our consortium partners, OWC is supporting the EIB
and MASEN across every aspect of this pioneering project, from market analysis
and technical assessments to geoscience, offshore wind design and marine
logistics."

title: Pacifico Energy backs South Korean offshore wind with $1billion commitment
content:
Pacifico Energy backs South Korean offshore wind with $1billion commitment TGS 4C | 4C Offshore News
Pacifico Energy backs South Korean offshore wind with $1billion commitment
Pacifico Energy has officially submitted an investment declaration of more
than $1 billion to South Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy.
The investment will be allocated between the 990 MW Manho
Offshore Wind Farm
and the 1.8 GW Jindo
Baram Offshore Wind Project.
The investment is part of broader growth across industries such as semiconductors,
AI data centers and cloud computing, all of which require renewable energy.
Pacifico Energy said offshore wind is well positioned to provide this much
needed energy.
Seung-Ho Choe, global head of offshore wind and representative director
of Pacifico Energy Korea, said: "Pacifico Energy has accelerated the
energy transition at industrial scale across the U.S. and the Asia-Pacific
region for more than a decade."
"Pacifico Energy Korea's offshore wind portfolio will supply clean
energy to bolster Korea's export competitiveness, while also building key
infrastructure to support the semiconductor cluster and RE100-ready industrial
complexes in Jeonnam-Gwangju."
The energy infrastructure developer is supporting offshore wind development
in South Korea through the 3.2 GW Jindo offshore wind cluster, which comprises
three projects, including the Myeong
Ryang Offshore Wind Project.

title: Scottish funding backs floating foundation facility at Port of Ardersier
content:
Scottish funding backs floating foundation facility at Port of Ardersier TGS 4C | 4C Offshore News
Scottish funding backs floating foundation facility at Port of Ardersier
Highlands and Islands Enterprise (HIE) has approved funding, following
collaboration with Scottish Development International (SDI), to help secure
a floating wind project for Scotland.
The plans involve producing floating offshore wind foundations at the Port
of Ardersier following approval of £778,000 in Scottish Government funding.
As part of the agreement, the funding will support an 18-month front-end
engineering and design (FEED) study led by BW Ideol, which aims to develop
the port as a specialist production facility for Damping Pool concrete
floating foundations.
The project aims to strengthen Scotland's position in the offshore wind
sector while supporting the country's net-zero targets.
Energy Minister Stephen Gethins said: "Once complete, this production
facility has the potential to generate more than 1,000 new well-paid, skilled
jobs, as well as create supply chain opportunities for businesses in the
Highlands and across the country.
"That's why the Scottish Government is backing its development with
more than £778,000 as part of our wider strategic investment in Scotland's
ports and offshore wind supply chain."

title: BloombergNEF’s South Africa Transition Factbook: Power-Market Reform and Private Investments Drive Energy Transition | BloombergNEF
content:
PRESS RELEASE
Clean Energy
September 7, 2026
KEY TAKEAWAYS
BloombergNEF’s (BNEF) factbook shows that grid constraints and high industrial electricity costs will determine how much investment and economic growth can be unlocked across the country by the energy transition.
South Africa is now pursuing a wholesale power market and private grid investment, while an aging coal fleet and rail constraints emerge as new bottlenecks to exports and growth.
,  September 7, 2026
– South Africa’s energy system is undergoing a major transition as the nation has moved beyond the worst of its power crisis, according to BloombergNEF’s (BNEF)
South Africa Transition Factbook 2026
. Persistent load shedding has ended after coal power plants returned to service and private-sector participation increased.
Private clean-power procurement is becoming a defining feature of South Africa’s electricity market. In 2026, corporate power purchase agreements (PPAs) are set to drive more utility-scale renewable additions in the country than government auctions for the first time. BNEF expects corporate buyers to support 73% of the 2.3 gigawatts of anticipated solar and wind additions in 2026. Corporate buyers remain the main driver of renewables through the end of the decade.
Investors, developers and corporate energy buyers are planning further investment in clean power capacity, but transmission grid capacity is emerging as a limiting factor in how quickly these investments can go ahead. Without faster grid expansion, South Africa’s energy transition may deliver less economic growth than expected.
The rise in clean-power investment is helping to cut fossil-fuel demand, but coal is still central to South Africa’s power system, supplying 78% of electricity in 2025, down from 90% in 2015. In BNEF’s Economic Transition Scenario (ETS), which gives an economics-led view of how the power sector evolves, solar, wind and battery storage increasingly shape the country’s future. As power consumption rises by 35% to 319TWh by 2050, solar and wind expand to supply 69% of that demand, while coal falls to 21% as aging plants retire and the coal fleet shrinks.
Nelson Nsitem, Africa Research Lead at BloombergNEF, said:
“South Africa’s energy transition has reached a critical inflection point.  To date, private companies have played a central role in bringing new clean power into the system, but the next phase will depend on whether infrastructure can keep pace with investment. Expanding the grid and bringing down electricity costs will be critical not only to deploying more renewables, but to strengthen South Africa’s competitiveness in industries such as critical minerals and manufacturing.”
Sofia Maia, Head of Middle East and Africa Research at BloombergNEF, said
: “For many South African businesses, investing in clean energy is no longer primarily a climate decision — it is increasingly about securing reliable power, managing costs and having greater control over their energy supply. That change in motivation is reshaping the country’s power market and creating a much bigger role for private investment.”
According to BNEF, South Africa is becoming increasingly reliant on China for clean-energy equipment. China accounted for 98% of solar and 95% of battery imports in 2025. In the region, China is also gaining shares in wind (80%) and electric vehicles (84%) from the US and Europe by offering lower-cost products to a price sensitive market. As sub-Saharan Africa becomes a larger market for Chinese clean-tech exports, South Africa has an opportunity to build domestic manufacturing and capture more of the region’s growing clean-energy supply chain.
Other key findings from the report include:
South Africa’s industrial decarbonization is becoming a competitiveness issue, not just an emissions issue
, as policies such as the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) increase pressure on emissions-intensive exports. South Africa’s industrial base is concentrated in energy-intensive mining and metals production, making these sectors central to the country’s decarbonization challenge. Coal’s dominant role in final energy demand highlights the potential for fuel switching and electrification to reduce industrial emissions.
South Africa has a strategic edge in energy-transition supply chains as a major supplier of strategic minerals
, such as platinum-group metals, manganese and chrome. Despite the opportunity, the nation captures relatively little value downstream as high power costs and infrastructure constraints weigh on competitiveness. High power prices are hampering the government’s ambition to grow its critical minerals industry, with average industrial electricity prices sitting at R1,652/MWh last year compared to R964/MWh in mainland China.
South Africa’s EV strategy could revive its auto competitiveness
. EV sales more than doubled in 2025, although they still accounted for 1% of the total South African passenger vehicle market. The sector is receiving incentives to produce EVs, for both the local and export markets, through measures including the enhanced Automotive Investment Scheme (AIS) and a 150% first-year tax deduction on investments in zero-emission vehicle manufacturing from March 2026. Shifting existing auto manufacturing capacity toward EVs could support South Africa’s export competitiveness as major overseas markets transition away from internal-combustion engines.
South Africa remains the largest market in sub-Saharan Africa renewable energy investment at $5.4 billion in 2025.
South Africa’s renewable energy investment fell 41% from $8.6 billion in 2024. Fewer utility-scale projects reached financial close in 2025, with utility solar down 57% to $1.4 billion, and onshore wind dropping 30% to $2.1 billion. Small-scale solar broke the trend, growing 35% to $1.8 billion and softening the overall drop.
South Africa Transition Factbook 2026
examines how the country’s key sectors are affected by the energy transition, where new opportunities and risks are emerging, and how mineral resources, local manufacturing and further policy reforms could shape competitiveness and long-term growth.

title: AES Andes begins testing 340 MW/1.36 GWh Cristales BESS - Energy Storage
content: AES Andes has started testing the battery energy storage system at its Cristales project in the Antofagasta region of northern Chile. The BESS has a power output of 340 MW and four hours of duration, equivalent to 1,360 MWh of storage capacity. During this stage, the company is verifying the operation of the equipment, control systems, and safety devices at the facility. AES Andes also said commissioning of the PV plant that forms part of the complex will begin soon. In its latest corporate information, the company lists Cristales’ solar capacity at 287-288 MW, while Chile’s Energy Ministry reports list the project in the testing phase with 400 MW of PV capacity. The latest Energy Sector Construction and Investment Projects Report, published in July, already included the Cristales BESS among systems undergoing testing. At 340 MW / 1,360 MWh, it was the second-largest system in the portfolio by power output, behind Grenergy’s 430 MW / 3,010 MWh Elena Phase I BESS. The project has undergone changes from its original configuration. When it was submitted for environmental assessment in 2023, it comprised 379 MW of PV capacity and a BESS of up to 542 MW with five hours of duration. In April 2024, the project received environmental approval. The authorized configuration included up to 340 MW of solar capacity and 542 MW of storage with five hours of duration, as well as the Cristales substation and a 220 kV transmission line. The planned investment at the time was $710 million. In August 2025, AES Andes announced the start of construction of Cristales and the Pampas project. For Cristales, the company announced a configuration of 288 MW of PV capacity and 340 MW of storage. The two projects represented a combined investment of more than $1.1 billion. title: EPC Renewables signs deal for Fiji solar and 240 MWh battery project - Energy Storage
content: Australia’s EPC Renewables and Spanish project developer Grupo Cobra have signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Energy Fiji Ltd. (EFL) for the development of a large-scale solar and battery project in Fiji. The Yaqara solar and battery project is to be delivered over two stages, with the initial phase comprising 22 MW of solar paired with a 40 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS). Stage two features 120 MW of solar generation and a 200 MWh BESS. EPC Renewables , formerly EPC Solar, will be responsible for the financing, development, construction, ownership, operation and maintenance of the solar and battery facility that is to be supported by a long-term energy supply arrangement with EFL. In addition to the agreement with EFL, EPC Renewables has also executed an MOU with Grupo Cobra , establishing a framework to collaborate on the delivery of engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) works for stage one and future project expansions. EFL said it will now work with EPC Renewables to finalize a power purchase agreement (PPA) by the first quarter of 2027. The parties are aiming for the solar and battery facility to achieve commercial operations by no later than the first quarter of 2029. EFL Chief Executive Officer Fatiaki Gibson said the project will support the authority’s plan to reduce Fiji’s reliance on imported diesel generation and increase renewable electricity generation from approximately 49% at present to 60% by 2029, and 90% by 2035. “EFL has set clear renewable energy targets, but ultimately our customers need to see these translated into projects connected to the grid,” he said in a statement. “Our focus now is on completing the necessary due diligence, negotiating a commercially acceptable power purchase agreement and ensuring the required transmission infrastructure progresses alongside the generation project.” EPC Renewables Managing Director Daryn Stocks said the project marks a significant milestone in the company’s evolution from an EPC contractor to a developer, owner and operator of renewable energy infrastructure across Australia, Fiji and the Pacific. “The Yaqara Project is a transformational opportunity for EPC Renewables,” he said. “This project establishes our first major IPP (independent power production) platform in Fiji and demonstrates our commitment to delivering reliable renewable energy infrastructure while creating long-term economic, employment and community benefits.” Stocks said the Yaqara project will significantly reduce Fiji’s reliance on imported diesel generation and improve long-term energy self-sufficiency. The integration of large-scale battery storage will further enhance grid stability and reliability by enabling renewable energy to be dispatched when it is needed most. He also noted it has the potential to create a foundation for long-term economic development in the region. A key focus of the development will be workforce participation and skills development. EPC Renewables expects the project to support the employment of approximately 200 Fijians, creating pathways into the renewable energy sector through electrical traineeships, apprenticeships and technical training programs. “As an Indigenous-focused renewable energy company, we are committed to ensuring the benefits of the energy transition extend beyond clean power,” Stocks said. “Through training, apprenticeships and employment opportunities, we aim to help build a skilled local workforce that can participate in Fiji’s renewable energy future.” The company said it will work alongside the Canberra Institute of Technology (CIT), the Smart Energy Council (SEC) and the Sustainable Energy Industry Association of the Pacific Islands (SEIAPI) to develop local renewable energy capabilities and establish long-term career opportunities for Fijians in engineering, electrical and clean energy industries. “Yaqara is more than a renewable energy project. It is a platform for regional growth, skills development and community participation,” Stocks said. title: PG&E and Rewiring America announce Google-funded virtual power plant program - Energy Storage
content: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), Rewiring America and Google have launched the Smart Home Assets for Reliability and Efficiency (SHARE) program, a virtual power plant (VPP) designed to deploy and manage flexible residential energy devices in the San Francisco Bay Area. In comments to pv magazine USA , PG&E and Rewiring America said they expect the SHARE program to reach approximately 12 MW of capacity by 2028, including capacity from new battery-enabled heat pumps and as many as 21,000 existing distributed energy resources like Tesla Powerwall batteries and smart home thermostats owned by PG&E customers. Rewiring America will handle customer signups and manage installer relationships, and funding for program operations and any incentives paid to participants will come from Google. PG&E will operate the VPP through its DERMS platform, issuing dispatch instructions and measuring performance. The utility plans to use the program to test the locational value of customer-sited resources, with both the enrollment of existing home energy devices and the regional development of privately funded new technologies structured around specific regional grid needs. “This is about delivering power at the speed our economy demands—while improving affordability and reliability for the people we serve,” said PG&E Chief Commercial Officer Chelle Izzi in a statement. “SHARE shows how investing in customers can unlock grid capacity, support growth, and bring real benefits back to communities.” To support the program’s operational goals, Demand Side Analytics will assist with distributed power plant orchestration, while software provider encoord will supply modeling analysis to evaluate how the VPP impacts and shapes demand on both the distribution and transmission grids. How homeowners can participate PG&E customers in Santa Clara and Alameda counties will be eligible to receive new high-efficiency, battery-enabled heat pumps from Carrier, with the cost of equipment and installation partially subsidized by Google. A report from Fast Company indicates that customers will receive a discount of at least $5,000 toward a heat pump installation, with $10,000 available to the first 25 households to sign up. Eligible Bay Area homeowners with existing distributed energy resources such as home batteries and smart thermostats will be invited to join the program from a pool of customers of Sunrun, Tesla and Renew Home. The three companies first revealed plans to provide aggregated customer-sited resources to utilities and hyperscalers in June, and the SHARE program is the first publicly-announced program to utilize that offering. PG&E says homeowners in the Sunrun/Tesla/Renew pool could receive ongoing incentives in exchange for participation (paid to customers separately from their electric bills), with the exact amount of those incentives dependent on technology, eligibility and enrollment wave. As an example of current compensation for VPP participation, Powerwall owners enrolled under Tesla’s existing Virtual Power Plant partnership with PG&E’s Emergency Load Reduction Program (ELRP) are compensated with $2.00 for every additional kilowatt-hour (kWh) their battery delivers to the grid during a dispatched event, which can total up to $350 per year depending on the number of grid emergencies. PG&E and Rewiring America say they will begin reaching out to eligible customers starting fall 2026. The partners expect the SHARE program to run through 2027, with initial findings from the program expected to be shared in late 2026 or early 2027. title: 1927-2027: Volvo celebrates 100 years with special-edition electric semi
content:
Commercial EVs
Electric Semi Truck
Jo Borrás
| Sep 7 2026 - 6:00 am PT
Volvo is celebrating its 100th anniversary with launch of a new, special edition Volvo FH16 Electric semi truck featuring special paint, interior upgrades, and a promise from the company to keep on keepin’ on for at least 100 more.
Volvo’s heavy-duty truck range has become safer, more powerful,
and more energy efficient with the launch of the latest FH and FH16 Electric models
– and the company is celebrating that century of progress with a unique new 100 Year Edition for its FH line featuring two-tone exterior design, a premium leather seat base with special 100 Year Edition embroidered on the grey textile of the upper half, and tan leather details that match the anniversary edition striping details on the truck’s paintwork.
“This special edition represents the peak of Volvo’s truck design and manufacture over the past century,” says Jan Hjelmgren, Head of Product Management at Volvo Trucks. “(It is) the result of 100 years’ worth of continual improvement in safety, quality, driver comfort, productivity, fuel efficiency and emissions saving.”
Details matter
The special-edition Volvo get unique illuminated doorsteps and LED strips on the console, switchable between red and white ambient mood lighting. An LED welcome light projects the 100 Year Edition branding onto the ground when the door opens, and the same design shows up on 3D-printed speaker grilles. Special sleeper cab curtains (shown, below) display a timeline of Volvo’s key truck models from the past century, and a thicker, more luxurious floor mat in a black/grey mélange with tan leather labels rounds out the interior upgrades.
Sexy sleeper curtains
100 Year Edition cab curtain; by Volvo.
“The 100-year edition truck is a celebration of what we have achieved so far over the past century, and a very special truck in more ways than one,” explains Volvo Trucks’ Design Director, Jonathan Disley. “The interior is both modern and premium, as well as an homage to Volvo’s history. The design was inspired by our Swedish heritage and the professionalism that comes from years of innovation and progress, alongside our customers’ trust and passion.”
The Volvo 100 Year Edition FH is the latest in a storied line of special edition Volvo models, which have previously included the Volvo FH 25 Year Special Edition, the Volvo FH Aero Euro NCAP Special Edition, and the Volvo Ocean Race Limited Edition.
The truck, itself

title: Audi reveals its new entry-level EV with over 400 miles of range starts at about $45,000
content:
Peter Johnson
| Sep 7 2026 - 6:46 am PT
The A2 e-tron is
most efficient vehicle ever, delivering over 400 miles of range. It’s also the brand’s affordable model, positioned as its new entry-level EV.
Audi A2 e-tron prices and EV range
original Audi A2
, which went on sale over 25 years ago, became known as the “world’s first four-door three-liter car” for its lightweight, ultra-efficient compact design.
Audi is bringing back the A2 name, and this time, it’s even more efficient with an all-electric powertrain.
The A2 e-tron has an energy consumption of just 12.8 kWh/ 100 km, according to WLTP, making it the most efficient series-production Audi of all time.
After unveiling the new entry-level EV for the first time on Monday, CEO Gernot Döllner said the A2 e-tron is “more than a new model,” calling it the brand’s “renewal.”
With a drag coefficient of just 0.24, the A2 e-tron (140 kW) has a WLTP range of up to 401 miles (646 km). It will be available with four power levels: 125 kW, 140 kW, 170 kW, and 240 kW, plus three battery sizes: 52, 61, or 84 kWh.
Audi A2 e-tron (Source: Audi)
Despite being an entry-level model, the A2 e-tron supports bidirectional charging, enabling it to power external electronics via Vehicle-to-Load (V2L). In Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, it can also be used as a backup home battery with a DC wall box via Vehicle-to-Home (V2H).
With DC fast-charging speeds of up to 183 kW, the 84 kWh battery can charge from 10% to 80% in about 29 minutes.
Audi A2 e-tron interior (Source: Audi)
The 52 kWh LFP battery takes about 14 minutes at up to 100 kW, while the 61 kWh battery takes 25 minutes at up to 105 kW.
Audi included several driver-assist features as standard, including Emergency brake assist, swerve assist, attention assist, adaptive cruise control (ACC), parking system plus, and a reversing camera.
Audi A2 e-tron interior (Source: Audi)
At just 4.32 meters (170″) long and 1.79 meters (70.5″) wide, with a wheelbase of 2.77 meters (109″), the A2 e-tron is about the size of the
and Volkswagen ID.3 Neo.
The smart storage and premium features make the interior feel more spacious despite its compact size.
Audi is the first luxury brand to offer the Fidlock fastening system, a patented magnetic smart storage solution, as standard. You can also opt for the optional panoramic glass roof with 1.6 square meters of glass across the roof.
Audi A2 e-tron (Source: Audi)
Orders will open on September 10, 2026, starting at €38,200 ($45,000) in Germany, for the base A2 e-tron 125 kW with the 52 kWh battery.
The 61 kWh variant starts at €41,900, while the A2 e-tron with 170 kW and the 84 kWh battery costs €48,900. The range-topping A2 e-tron 240 kW starts at €51,200.
Audi is building the A2 e-tron at its Ingolstadt plant in Germany. The first customer deliveries are expected to begin in December 2026.
Will Audi bring the entry-level EV to the US? It hasn’t been confirmed yet, but don’t get your hopes up. The A2 is built in Germany specifically for the European market.

title: Evoke’s new $5,000 electric motorcycle can hit highway speeds, coming to US & EU
content:
Micah Toll
| Sep 7 2026 - 6:30 am PT
Electric motorcycles have long had a pricing problem. While battery-powered scooters and e-bikes have increasingly pushed into affordable territory, highway-capable electric motorcycles still tend to carry fairly hefty price tags.
Evoke Motorcycles
is hoping to change that with its newly unveiled 2027 Evoke Nrgy, a lightweight electric motorcycle targeting a starting price of just $4,995.
And unlike many lower-cost electric two-wheelers, this one is actually designed to handle the highway.
The new Evoke Nrgy tops out at 120 km/h (75 mph), putting it comfortably above typical urban electric motorcycles and scooters and giving riders enough speed for a mix of city, suburban, and highway riding.
That aligns it with other popular light electric motorcycles like
Ryvid Anthem,
going beyond the realm of overpowered electric mopeds and allowing true highway jaunts.
Evoke plans to offer the bike in two versions. The Nrgy 6 gets a 6.4 kWh battery and carries that targeted US $4,995 starting price, while the Nrgy 8 bumps the battery capacity up to 8.4 kWh and is expected to start at US $6,495.
Interestingly, both use lithium-iron phosphate (LFP) battery cells instead of the more energy-dense chemistries commonly found in electric motorcycles. LFP batteries generally trade some energy density for advantages including improved thermal stability, longer cycle life, and potentially lower costs.
Evoke hasn’t yet announced range figures for either model, so we’ll have to wait to see just how far those fairly sizable packs can carry the Nrgy. But with battery packs landed squarely in the ‘modest’ category, these bikes will likely be best suited for urban riding with some short but fun higher speed sections thrown in – not long distance touring.
The bike is built around Evoke’s patented Twin Plate chassis architecture and features disc brakes at both ends. The styling is also fairly distinctive, with large slab-sided body panels surrounding the battery area, a traditional-looking faux tank up top, and a minimalist tail. It’s an interesting mix of futuristic electric motorcycle design with some conventional motorcycle cues, and appears to draw some inspiration from the previous 6061 model we saw from Evoke
several years ago.
“The Evoke Nrgy fills an important gap in our global product portfolio,” explained Evoke CEO Nathan Siy, adding that the company aimed to create a lightweight electric motorcycle without sacrificing “performance, safety or build quality.”
The company is positioning the Nrgy as a global model, targeting Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America. Final regional pricing, homologation details, preorder timing, and delivery schedules are expected to be announced in the coming months.
At $5,000, the Nrgy could find itself in an interesting position, assuming it meets its pricing goals. That’s still considerably more expensive than the growing crop of high-powered electric bikes and e-motos, but it’s getting into a much more approachable price range for something capable of legitimate highway speeds.
Of course, that $5k figure is still a
price, and we’ve yet to see range figures or final regional specifications. But if the Beijing-based company can actually deliver a 75 mph electric motorcycle with a 6.4 kWh LFP battery in the US for around five grand, that combination could make lightweight electric motorcycles a lot easier to justify.

title: If a Tesla Cybercab fleet were profitable, Tesla wouldn't sell you one
content:
Robotaxi
Fred Lambert
| Sep 7 2026 - 7:38 am PT
Tesla is now asking businesses whether they’d like to buy and operate their own fleets of Cybercab robotaxis on its network. It’s the same pitch Elon Musk has been making since 2019: buy the cars, put them to work, and earn money while you sleep.
There’s one problem with it. And it never happened, and you shouldn’t fall for it now. If running a fleet of Cybercabs were actually profitable, Tesla wouldn’t sell you a single one.
The pitch Tesla keeps making
At its Cybercab event on September 3, Tesla started
circulating an interest form to fleet buyers
asking who wants in on “Cybercab fleet vehicle purchasing.” The idea is that a company buys the cars, runs them on Tesla’s Robotaxi network, and splits the revenue.
We’ve heard this before. At Autonomy Day in 2019, Musk told the world that owners could add their cars to the “Tesla Network” and pull in as much as $30,000 a year in gross profit per vehicle. Same year, he called Teslas
“appreciating assets”
that would gain value as Full Self-Driving improved.
None of it happened. Owners paid up to $15,000 for FSD on the promise of taxi income, and years later,
not one of them can run their car as a robotaxi
. Tesla runs the service itself. The people who funded the dream are still waiting.
Ask MisterGreen how that worked out
Some people actually built a business on Musk’s promise. MisterGreen, a Dutch leasing firm, went all-in on Tesla, buying
more than 4,000 of them
on the belief that the cars would hold their value and eventually earn robotaxi income.
Instead, Tesla spent two years slashing new-car prices, and used Teslas started depreciating at roughly three times the rate of the broader used-car market. The robotaxi income never came. MisterGreen went bankrupt in December 2025 and wiped out its bondholders. $40 million was lost.
That’s what betting on the “appreciating asset” looks like in practice. Not great.
Why selling you a robotaxi is the tell
Tesla is not a charity. It aims to maximize profits. Tesla builds the Cybercab. It owns the Robotaxi network, the software, the dispatch, and the pricing. It sets the split. If a Cybercab on that network genuinely printed $30,000 a year, why would Tesla hand that money to a stranger instead of keeping every car for itself?
Companies don’t outsource money machines. They outsource risk. Selling you the Cybercab means you eat the capital cost and the depreciation, while Tesla keeps the software margin and its cut of every fare.
And you’d be competing directly against the company that controls the platform. Tesla can undercut your prices, prioritize its own cars in the app, change the revenue split, or geofence you out entirely. You don’t own a business in that arrangement. You own the downside.
Electrek’s Take
This is asset-light offloading dressed up as an opportunity. Tesla wants fleet buyers to absorb the capex and the depreciation on hundreds of thousands of Cybercabs so it can book the vehicle sale, keep the high-margin software, and skim the network. The risk moves to you. The margin stays with Tesla.
It’s the FSD playbook again. Sell the promise of future income, collect the money up front, and let the buyer hold the bag when the economics don’t materialize. MisterGreen is the case study, and it’s barely nine months old.
I also know of another company that built a Tesla fleet in LA in 2018-2020 in preparation for the infamous ‘Tesla Network’ revenue that never materialized. They had to shut down shortly after.
If robotaxi fleets were the goldmine Musk describes, Tesla is sitting on the cash, the factories, and the network to run them all itself and never share a dollar. Instead, it’s passing around the gold out of the goodness of its heart. Please. That should tell you everything about who’s meant to carry the risk here. So before anyone signs up to buy a fleet of Cybercabs, the question worth asking is simple: if this is such easy money, why is Tesla so eager to let you have it?

title: Review: Engwe's $900 Eagle isn't just the best-priced 45mph mini eMoto
content:
Seth Weintraub
| Sep 7 2026 - 7:10 am PT
Engwe came to us a month ago with the
and asked if we’d like to review it. The eMoto looks and is specced a lot like some of the other 14/12″ mullet mini eMotos that have flooded the market over the past year, which wasn’t immediately enticing. However, the Eagle smashes through that $1000 price point to
$899 after coupon code ELECTREKCO (plus some limited-time gifts)
. We thought it would be useful to see how they did it and what we found might surprise you.
Engwe is a brand
we’ve reviewed before and has a
track record
of building solid value ebikes.
The Eagle builds on the small Tuttio/Yozma 14/12-inch wheel form factor that has become incredibly popular for pre-teens and teens throughout the US. These are obviously off-road bikes and aren’t legal on the road in almost any jurisdiction. The spec sheet will look somewhat familiar:
3200W Peak Mid-drive Motor
F14″/R12″ Off-Road Tires
Top Speed
Waterproof Rating
Maximum Range
55 Miles(Throttle Mode)
52V 27Ah Lithium-Ion Battery
200mm Hydraulic Disc Brakes
Suspension
Full Suspension
Maximum Climbing Degree
Charging Time
5-6 Hours (3A Charger)
Front Light
LED Headlight
LCD Display
Max Load Capacity
Bike Weight
Material
High carbon steel
Note the higher 220nm torque than not just Tuttio and Yozma, but even the higher-end Heybike Villan. That’s going to get you off the line, up the hill, and into a wheelie much better than higher-priced bikes. The 3.2kW motor falls in the midrange between Yozma (2.6kW) and Heybike (4.2kW), but the stated range of 55 miles is higher than both. Obviously, 1.4kWh battery range estimates are highly subjective, and in the real world, going 28mph you’ll get 30-35 miles, give or take, depending on rider weight, terrain, weather, and other factors. We reviewed the red option, but I think the Black and Gray version might be the star here:
Engwe Eagle differentiators
I wasn’t expecting to love the trade-offs for getting to a sub $900 price point. But they are actually quite remarkable. First of all, there are no keys. Instead, you can remove power from the moto by taking the red kill switch off (an easily replaceable safety feature as well). The seat is removable with a big screw at the bottom, and the battery is secured with a heavy-duty strap. This isn’t going to prevent theft, but it also isn’t going to hinder your experience if you lose your keys.
Also, Engwe forgoes the Fardriver controller that many of these eMotos use and has a custom setup (which very well could be a Fardriver controller on lockdown). While that restricts Bluetooth access to program the controller, it also lets Engwe deliver a strong mix of torque, power, and range that beats other bikes in its class. You can also access the P-settings menu, which allows users to restrict top speed, switch between kilometers and miles, adjust backlighting, and change sleep and other settings.
The 4.7-inch big, waterproof color display is surprisingly one of the best we’ve seen, with large, high-contrast, readable speed/ride mode (0-3), Battery meter, status, and odometer numbers. The left-hand, 5-button thumb controller is also very usable, and both the horn and front headlight are perfectly usable safety features.
I was also pleasantly surprised by how easy the Eagle was to assemble. Engwe made the kickstand and pegs very easy to install, and the rest of the eMoto probably took us about 30 mins to put together. With an ~80% charged battery, we were ripping within an hour of the box landing on our doorstep.
Reality mode:
Look, this is a sub-
$900 eMoto so don’t expect a $1000 suspension package on here.
As a 200-lb rider, I bottomed out a few times on the trails, and the suspension was probably as baseline as it gets. At 6 feet tall, riding it felt cramped, as a friend tells me on these bikes; I seem a little bit like a circus clown attempting a high-wire act.
However, for my much lighter son, this is actually a pretty incredible ride. No complaints on the hills, though we were hesitant to bring it near significant jumps.
Engwe includes a 3A charger which charges the bike in 5-6 hours, with an optional $99 8A charger that drops charging time to 2-3 hours. That’s great and better than some competitors, but the charging head is proprietary, and it isn’t interchangeable with other electronics, which is a bit frustrating.
Like all of these eMotos, a top speed of 45 mph is attainable only under optimal conditions (like a slight downhill, crouch, and tailwind), but hitting 40 on a dirt straightaway is very possible, especially for lighter riders, and I’m sure that with enduro tires 45mph is doable. In reality, you’ll be tooling around mostly in the high 30s, which is still lots of fun and probably a lot safer than going highway speeds.
Speaking of safety, any kid riding an emoto hard should be wearing lots of safety gear and much beefier stuff than is included in the Engwe package. Also, in reality, kids are going to take these on roads whether that’s just around the neighborhood or down the road to get to the dirt track, so they should be fully protected and schooled in safety protocols.
Electrek’s take
I’m still blown away at this package at this price. The Eagle is one of the better 14/12 eMotos out there at any price, and the fact that you can pick up a 45mph electric bike for $899 from a reputable brand from US storefronts is bananas. It bodes well for the future of electric transportation if we can get homologated street bikes out to the masses at these prices.
At $900, I expected a glaring disappointment compared to the other emotos in its class, which are as much as $500 more, but instead found that Engwe managed some nice improvements (torque, display, controls, kill switch) over its competitors with very little in sacrifices (suspension?). If you are 6’+ and 200lbs like me, I’d
recommend hitting up a bigger bike like this Qronge.
But 5’9/180lbs and under? Pick up the
Engwe Eagle for $899 using code Electrekco
at checkout to receive a bunch of gifts (currently pictured below), or at
Amazon without gifts by clicking the $100 off box
. Labor Day weekend only.

title: VW's new ID. Polo is apparently sold out, with over 30,000 orders and a 10-month waitlist
content:
Volkswagen
Peter Johnson
| Sep 7 2026 - 8:45 am PT
Volkswagen’s
new ID. Polo EV is apparently sold out after receiving over 30,000 orders. Buyers are now being told it will be at least a 10-month wait.
Is the Volkswagen ID. Polo sold out?
Volkswagen is betting on its new family of electric city cars to fight back against Chinese automakers like BYD.
So far, it’s apparently off to a promising start. After
opening orders for the ID. Polo
at the end of April, the entry-level EV has received more than 30,000 orders ahead of its official launch.
According to German newspaper
Automobilwoche
, the VW ID. Polo is already sold out across all trims. The head of a larger VW dealership said the waitlist for the electric city car has now reached at least 10 months.
Volkswagen confirmed the report, telling
Automobilwoche
that the response has been “very positive,” but it’s leading to longer-than-expected delivery delays.
“Everyone is switching to electric cars they can afford,” a dealership group executive said. The base
VW ID. Polo Trend
with the 37 kWh battery, starts at just €24,995, or about $29,000, and offers a WLTP range of 334 km (207 miles).
Volkswagen ID. Polo Trend (Source: Volkswagen)
Volkswagen is ramping up production to meet higher-than-expected demand at its Martorell plant in Spain.
The Skoda Epiq and Cupra Raval, which share the same MEB+ platform and are built at the same facility, are facing a similar situation.
Volkswagen ID. Polo and Cupra Raval enter production at SEAT & CUPRA plant in Martorell (Source: Volkswagen)
According to company sources, Volkswagen’s entry-level electric SUV, the ID. Cross, is also seeing strong initial demand. VW
opened orders for the ID. Cross
, the electric counterpart to its best-selling T-Cross in Europe, in July, starting at €27,995 in Germany, or roughly $32,000.
Electrek’s Take
While the initial response to Volkswagen’s new lineup of lower-priced electric city cars has been stronger than expected, the company still faces an uphill battle.
Volkswagen’s supervisory board
approved its Future Plan 2030
last week, calling for additional job cuts (up to 100,000 globally), a trimmed model lineup, and more plant closures.
The restructuring package comes as the German automaker aims to cut costs and keep pace with Chinese brands, like BYD, that are leading the auto industry’s shift to electric.

title: Jeep Wagoneer EREV Production Delayed By 6 Months: Report
content:
Jeep Wagoneer EREV Production Delayed By 6 Months: Report
The Jeep Wagoneer EREV will start production in November, Automotive News reported. The Ram 1500 EREV is coming next year.
- Stellantis has delayed Jeep Wagoneer EREV production to November, Automotive News reported on Friday.
- The company says its EREV plans are still on track for 2026 and 2027.
- Automotive News says the delay is due to powertrain issues.
Stellantis was early to the extended-range EV (EREV) bandwagon, announcing what was then known as the Ram 1500 Ramcharger back in 2023. Now Jeep and Ram's generator-powered EVs are arriving later than expected, according to a report from Automotive News.
The Jeep Wagoneer EREV is now due to start production in November, the outlet reported, citing a memo sent to suppliers. Previously, production was supposed to start in May, the memo said. Ram 1500 REV production is set for next April, a delay from mid-2026, Automotive News reported.
Stellantis told Automotive News that the two vehicles are still on track. "Both Jeep and Ram are on track as planned. Jeep for this year and Ram for 2027," a spokesperson told the outlet.
Two supplier executives working on the program told Automotive News that the vehicles were pushed to make sure the rollout of this new kind of powertrain—one that pairs an EV platform with a V6 generator—goes smoothly.
This isn’t the first set of delays for Stellantis’ large electrified models. In 2023, Ram unveiled both electric and EREV versions of the 1500 pickup. The goal was to launch the models by 2024. That hasn’t happened. The full EV version of the Ram 1500 was canceled last year, and the brand focused on its EREV models instead. The EREV pickup has faced numerous delays.
The Jeep Wagoneer EREV Hybrid and Ram 1500 REV will share a powertrain. The driving experience is expected to feel electrified, with a 400-volt battery and electric motors providing the propulsion for the vehicle. But there will be a V6 engine and a gas tank, which will turn a generator that provides electricity to turn the wheels. The gas engine isn’t connected directly to the wheels at all. The idea is to extend the driving range when the battery runs out of electricity, and help extend range while towing.
The concept is very popular in China, especially amongst large luxury SUVs. Some automakers have theorized that this could be a great way to get drivers to electrify and placate fears of range and charging anxiety. Ford’s F-150 Lightning is gone, but it will return as an EREV, which could be better suited to large truck drivers not convinced of full EV models. Scout is launching its Traveler and Terra models in EV and EREV form, but the EREV has made up the majority of its reservations.

title: The Audi A2 E-Tron Packs Up To 401 Miles Of Range And Serious Efficiency
content:
The Audi A2 E-Tron Packs Up To 401 Miles Of Range And Serious Efficiency
The new A2 follows in its predecessor's footsteps, with impressive efficiency and quirky styling.
The original Audi A2 was a bit of an oddity when it debuted back in 1999, but today it sits comfortably among the icons of the four-ring brand. Nearly 21 years after the aluminum-bodied efficiency special ended production, Audi is giving the idea of a distinctive, highly technical small car another chance.
The name is familiar, but the concept behind it is new: The new A2 e-tron will arrive at the end of 2026 as Audi's cheapest electric car, set to be built in Ingolstadt. During an initial static preview of the new A2 e-tron, we got a detailed first look at the car and spoke with those responsible for its technology and development.
Gallery: Audi A2 e-tron (2027)
Dimensions and design
At 170.1 inches (4.32 meters) long, the A2 e-tron sits squarely in the traditional compact segment. Thanks to the same underpinnings as the Volkswagen ID.3 Neo and Cupra Born, Audi's new entry-level EV boasts a rather impressive 108.8-inch (2,764 mm) wheelbase, the same as the larger Q4 e-tron. This leads to more interior room, despite having a smaller body overall.
Audi is also taking an efficiency-focused approach to aerodynamics. In its most economical configuration, the A2 e-tron has a drag coefficient of 0.24. To achieve that, engineers developed air curtains at the front, so-called gap reducers around the wheel arches, and an active cooling-air intake. The latter remains closed during normal driving and opens only when cooling is needed—for example, while charging, under high power demand, or in high ambient temperatures. The underbody is also completely flat.
According to Audi, the aerodynamic tweaks can reduce WLTP energy consumption in the 188-horsepower model with the efficiency package by up to 1.4 kWh per 100 miles (0.9 kWh/100 kilometers), bringing it down to 20.6 kWh/100 miles (12.8 kWh/100 km). The efficiency pack is offered only for the 188 hp version and includes the sleeker S line exterior package, the sport suspension, and special 19-inch aero wheels with lower-rolling-resistance tires. As a general rule of thumb, the A2 rides on wheels ranging from 18 to 20 inches.
Just like any modern Audi, the new A2 e-tron has some pretty fancy exterior lights, with four individual signatures, one of which is an active digital signature with an animated effect. At the rear, it also features active turn signals.
The doors are completely flush, with small grab handles, similar to those fitted to the Ford Mustang Mach-E. They operate electrically and include a secondary safety layer in case the vehicle electronics fail after damage.
Another everyday-use detail is the towing capacity: All power levels are expected to be able to tow up to 3,527 pounds (1,600 kilograms). According to Audi, that explicitly includes the entry-level model.
Our first impression of the styling: Audi has succeeded in separating the A2 from its corporate siblings while also giving a subtle nod to the original A2. The rear end in particular, with its squared-off, spoiler-like finish in the style of its predecessor and its sharp taillights—am I the only one seeing a hint of Honda Integra Type R here?—works well. Various design details and the finish look distinctly premium and help separate the A2 e-tron from its many, including Chinese, competitors. Given the prices, that is also absolutely necessary. More on that in a moment.
Interior, cargo space, and infotainment
For infotainment, Audi uses its now-familiar panoramic display with an 11.9-inch digital instrument cluster and a 12.8-inch infotainment screen. An optional augmented-reality head-up display projects speed, navigation instructions, and media information into the driver’s field of view.
Climate controls are handled through the central screen, though Audi has at least put some functions on the steering wheel, which features proper buttons and rollers. And for those who like talking to their car, cloud-based AI models support more natural voice interaction. A route planner with charging stops is also integrated, but that should no longer surprise anyone.
Audi is among the first automakers to bring the advantages of the Fidlock system into one of its vehicles. Fidlock combines strong magnets with a mechanical latch, allowing items such as a cupholder, a charging-cable bag, or a cargo-area strap to be attached very easily and positioned flexibly. I found it to be a useful new feature during my brief time with the new EV.
Three modular Fidlock adapters in the center console and a matching cupholder are standard. The center console also offers numerous storage areas, including open space for a handbag and a closed compartment beneath the center armrest.
Because it is a standardized system, all compatible Fidlock products—including those from the cycling or outdoor worlds—can also be used in the vehicle. Optional, for whatever reason, are three additional Fidlock points in the cargo area: two in the left-side cargo trim and one in the right-side cargo trim. Audi says the system will continue to be expanded over time.
Another interesting new feature is optional Audi Connected Work. The system can link to a Microsoft 365 business account and, for example, summarize the day’s appointments, read emails aloud, or bring a Teams call onto the screen.
Wireless smartphone charging is standard. The gear selector moves to the steering column in the A2 e-tron, freeing up space for two charging trays that secure phones magnetically and charge at up to 25 watts. The front doors can hold PET bottles of up to 42 ounces (1.25 liters), while the center console can accommodate 51-ounce (1.5-liter) bottles. In total, Audi touts beverage storage for up to 1.1 gallons (4 liters).
As for interior space, Ingolstadt is deliberately not positioning the A2 e-tron as a traditional small car. Instead, Audi describes it as a vehicle that could serve as a family’s primary car, pointing to range and towing capacity as well. Based on this first look experience, that claim is not unfounded. There's a good sense of space in the front seats, and the rear bench is fairly generous, even with yours truly, at 6 feet 1 inch (1.85 meters), sitting behind his own driving position. There is also enough headroom, even with the optional 17.2-square-foot (1.6-square-meter) glass roof.
One compartment farther back, things look good too: Cargo volume measures 14.0 to 47.2 cubic feet (396 to 1,336 liters). Audi emphasizes usability here: Three large suitcases can fit with the load floor lowered. The team had them on hand during the preview, and they did fit. There is also a frunk with a rather modest 0.5 cubic foot (13 liters) of volume, though that is enough for a charging cable or small dirty items.
As with the recent Q4 e-tron facelift and the new Q7, the A2 e-tron gives the impression that Audi has taken criticism of its interior quality to heart. The materials do not feel luxurious, but they do make a more than acceptable impression. The so-called “Soft Wrap”—the fabric covering that extends from the dashboard into the rear doors—is appealing. Audi also now uses very soft plastic over larger areas, even on the lower sections of the inner doors.
Powertrains and batteries
Technically, the A2 e-tron is based on a version of the Volkswagen Group’s MEB 31 architecture, the platform also used, unsurprisingly, by the ID.3 Neo and Cupra Born. When asked what exactly is going on with MEB and MEB Plus, and the differences between them, product manager Herman Verbeek responded almost smugly.
He said MEB Plus is a term that has become common in the press but does not officially exist. There is the aforementioned platform as Variant 2 for the Audi Q4 e-tron, Volkswagen ID.4, and similar models, and then there is Variant 1, which the new A2 e-tron uses. The soon-to-arrive Volkswagen ID. Polo and Cupra Raval will use MEB 21, the smaller front-wheel-drive version of the architecture. Just to settle that once and for all.
Audi A2 e-tron (2027)
While the larger MEB 31 vehicles, such as the Q4 e-tron, are also available with all-wheel drive, that is not planned for Platform Variant 1. In other words, there will be no A2 e-tron with electric quattro all-wheel drive. According to the engineers, all-wheel drive was considered, but the expected volumes for such a version in the compact segment would be too low to justify the additional development work.
Four output levels are planned at launch: 168, 188, 228, and 322 horsepower. All versions are rear-wheel drive, and the most powerful variant is said to accelerate from 0 to 62 miles per hour (0-100 kilometers per hour) in 5.7 seconds, while topping out at 124 mph (200 kph). A version with even more power is in development, so expect an S2 e-tron that could potentially land in the roughly 375- to 402-hp range.
For propulsion, Audi uses updated versions of the familiar APP350 and APP550 electric motors. The power electronics use silicon-carbide semiconductors, which are intended to minimize losses. There are four recuperation levels, one of which is designed to enable one-pedal driving.
The battery lineup is a bit more complicated. There are three battery sizes: 52, 61, and 84 kilowatt-hours. Audi uses lithium iron phosphate cells, or LFP, for the two smaller batteries and promises a robust chemistry with good aging stability. They are built using a cell-to-pack design. Meanwhile, the 84-kWh nickel-manganese-cobalt battery, or NMC, is module-based and reserved for the 228- and 322-hp versions.
Driving range tops out at 401 miles (646 km) on the WLTP cycle, depending on the combination of motor, battery, and equipment. (That would translate to roughly 343 miles on the EPA cycle) The aforementioned 188-hp version with the efficiency package records the lowest WLTP consumption at 20.6 kWh/100 miles (12.8 kWh/100 km).
Fast-charging capability also varies by version. According to Audi, the two more powerful models with the 84-kWh battery can charge at up to 183 kW DC, with a 10-to-80% session taking about 29 minutes. The 188-hp version can charge at up to 105 kW, while the base version reaches up to 100 kW.
Asked about the somewhat modest 100- and 105-kW maximum charging rates in the lower-output A2 versions, Audi counters that the LFP battery, thanks to its cell chemistry, can accept a high charging rate across a relatively broad state-of-charge window.
Here's an overview of all the specs:
| Technical data | A2 e-tron 125 kW | A2 e-tron 140 kW | A2 e-tron 170 kW | A2 e-tron 240 kW |
| Drive | Rear motor; 125 kW (168 hp); 350 Nm (258 lb-ft) | Rear motor; 140 kW (188 hp); 350 Nm (258 lb-ft) | Rear motor; 170 kW (228 hp); 350 Nm (258 lb-ft) | Rear motor; 240 kW (322 hp); 545 Nm (402 lb-ft) |
| 0-62 mph / Vmax | 8,8 s / 99 mph (160 kph) | 7,9 s / 99 mph (160 kph) | 7,0 s / 99 mph (160 kph) | 5,7 s / 124 mph (200 kph) |
| Battery capacity (usable/gross) | 50 / 52 kWh | 58 / 61 kWh | 79 / 84 kWh | 79 / 84 kWh |
| WLTP consumption/100 km | 13,7 kWh | 12,8 kWh | 13,9 kWh | 14,2 kWh |
| WLTP Range | 263 miles (423 km) | 320 miles (515 km) | 401 km (646 km) | 391 miles (630 km) |
| Max. charging power AC / DC | 11 / 100 kW | 11 / 105 kW | 11 / 183 kW | 11 / 183 kW |
| 10-80% DC charge time | 24 min | 26 min | 29 min | 29 min |
| Weight | 4,056 lbs (1,840 kg) | 4,056 lbs (1.840 kg) | 4,210 lbs (1,910 kg) | 4,255 lbs (1,930 kg) |
Bidirectional charging is also included. Vehicle-to-load, or V2L, allows external devices to be powered at up to 3.6 kW via a 230-volt outlet in the cargo area or through an adapter that plugs into the charge port. That means the A2 e-tron can run tools, an electric grill, or other devices, for example.
Vehicle-to-home, or V2H, can also turn the vehicle into an energy storage unit for the house. A compatible DC wallbox is required, however. At launch, V2H is initially planned for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
Despite its technical relationship to other MEB models, Audi wants to give the A2 e-tron its own, more dynamic character through chassis tuning. The steering and damper calibration were specifically adapted. Progressive steering is available depending on equipment. Thanks in part to rear-wheel drive, the turning circle is just over 33 feet (10 meters).Pricing and equipment
Price and equipment
The Audi A2 e-tron will be available to order in Germany starting in fall 2026, with deliveries beginning in December. The German-market starting price is €38,200 euros ($44,400 at current exchange rates). Meanwhile, a comparable Volkswagen ID.3 Neo starts at €33,995.
That's quite the difference, but standard equipment on the entry-level A2 e-tron is extensive. It includes the large curved display, navigation, a rearview camera, Level 2 driver-assistance functions, wireless smartphone charging, and bidirectional charging functions. Three equipment packages—Tech, Tech Plus, and Tech Pro—will also be offered. Annoyingly, at this price point, the heat pump costs extra.
The 61-kWh version starts at €41,900. In 228-hp form with the 84-kWh battery, the A2 e-tron costs €48,900. The top-spec A2 e-tron with 322 hp is priced at €51,200. There are currently no plans to sell the A2 e-tron in the United States.
The bottom line
Technically, the new Audi A2 e-tron is a polished VW ID.3 Neo tuned for maximum efficiency. There are certainly worse starting points, but the designers have managed to give it a character of its own and, surprisingly, quite a bit of presence. The first impression is promising, including the perceived quality and thoughtful packaging of the interior.
Here’s hoping it has a better fate than its predecessor and doesn't have to wait 15 to 20 years after production ends to be properly appreciated. Its pricing is certainly ambitious, but we're looking forward to the first drive.

title: 2025 年国际邀请赛冠军 Team Falcons 宣布退出《Dota 2》领域
content:
IT之家 9 月 7 日消息，沙特阿拉伯电子竞技组织 Team Falcons 当地时间本月 6 日宣布退出《Dota 2》领域。Team Falcons《Dota 2》战队曾在去年赢得国际邀请赛冠军，今年则收获国际邀请赛第 7~8 名。
Team Falcons 表示，此举是因为其“全球战略重心正转向拓展那些能为组织带来更强战略契合度及长期运营可持续性的生态系统”。
完整公告译文如下：
在 Team Falcons，我们的目标是在全球电竞领域打造具有长期影响力的项目。经过对 2026 年及以后多项目发展路线图的战略评估，我们决定退出《Dota 2》领域。
尽管《Dota 2》在竞技游戏领域占据着传奇般的地位，但我们的全球战略重心正转向拓展那些能为组织带来更强战略契合度及长期运营可持续性的生态系统。
最重要的是，我们向那些为这面队旗倾尽全力的非凡选手、教练及后勤团队致以最深切的谢意。从最初的日子到最终在汉堡高举 TI 奖杯，你们的才华、牺牲和不懈奋斗造就了今天的我们。我们为共同创造的成就感到无比自豪，并将全力支持大家迈向人生的新阶段。
这并非是我们雄心的倒退，而是为迈向未来而进行的专注推进。当我们把精力转向新的地平线时，我们会将每一场胜利和每一份教训都铭记于心。最重要的是，致我们的粉丝：感谢你们坚定不移的热情，感谢你们在赛场上的呐喊，感谢你们在聊天室里的支持，以及一路上给予我们的每一份关爱。猎鹰队的征程仍在继续，我们迫不及待地想要与大家分享接下来的故事。

title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 模型自主通关 3D 解谜游戏《传送门》：耗时 24 小时，成本 571 美元
content:
IT之家 9 月 7 日消息，一名 AI 和大语言模型爱好者近日进行了一项实验，让 OpenAI 的新模型 GPT-6 Astra 自主通关了 Valve 旗下 3D 解谜游戏《传送门》。
从结果来看，这对大语言模型而言无疑是极具突破性的进步，也是对多模态“AI 智能”的一次颇具说服力的展示。不久之前，AI 甚至还会在 Atari 2600 国际象棋游戏中输掉比赛，而如今已经能够自主通关整个 3D 解谜游戏。
这次《传送门》通关过程共进行了 3336 次工具调用，按照 API 价格计算，成本达 571.18 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,838 元人民币）。
实验发起者 CozyBlaze 随后澄清称，这些成本实际上由其每月 200 美元（现汇率约合 1,344 元人民币）的 Codex Pro 订阅服务覆盖。
CozyBlaze 解释称：“模型通过 MCP，也就是 Model Context Protocol，以及经过修改的 SourcePauseTool 来控制《传送门》。模型思考时，游戏会保持暂停状态；当模型发送一组输入指令后，SPT 会解除暂停并执行这些操作。”
在 AI 进行思考期间，系统会向其提供游戏截图以及玩家角色所在位置等信息。随后，游戏恢复运行，GPT-6 Astra 按照自己规划好的步骤执行移动和其他操作。
这也解释了为什么经过剪辑的精彩视频长度约为 2 小时，但 GPT-6 Astra 游玩《传送门》的完整视频直播记录加起来却长达约 24 小时。
对于这次实验成果，CozyBlaze 的态度相当务实。他承认，目前仍然存在许多需要解决的问题，这次通关过程也不应该被视为 AI 能力的标准化基准测试。
不过，他表示：“但看到一个通用型智能体能够自主探索游戏世界，并最终一路完成整个游戏，会让人感觉最初的愿景正在逐渐成为现实。”
CozyBlaze 所说的“最初愿景”，指的是 OpenAI 早在 2016 年提出的一项长期目标。当时，OpenAI 曾设想，未来能够打造一个单一 AI 智能体，让它解决各种不同类型的游戏任务。
GPT-6 Astra 于本月早些时候成为 OpenAI 的新旗舰模型。OpenAI 表示，新模型代表了“新一代智能”，并且在计算机操作、网页浏览、软件工程、网络安全、科学研究以及专业工作等领域达到了当前最先进水平。
预计在未来几天里，会看到 Astra 大展其强大的智能能力。

title: Steam 今年已为 Valve 带来 150 亿美元收入，《极限竞速：地平线 6》领跑新作
content:
IT之家 9 月 7 日消息，对于 Valve 来说，2026 年显然又是一个“赚得盆满钵满”的年份，这一切都要归功于 Steam 强大的吸金能力。
根据最新分析数据，这个 PC 游戏平台今年至今已经为 Valve 带来了 150 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,007.91 亿元人民币）的收入。这一数字指的是 Valve 通过在 Steam 平台销售游戏、DLC 和软件所获得的分成收入。
那么，2026 年 Steam 上为 Valve 带来最多收入的新游戏是哪一款？根据 Alinea Analytics 的最新数据，答案是《极限竞速：地平线 6》。
该机构估计，这款开放世界赛车游戏已经为 Valve 创造了约 2.105 亿美元（现汇率约合 14.14 亿元人民币）的收入。
紧随其后的是另一款 2026 年的热门作品《红色沙漠》，预计已经为 Valve 带来约 2.033 亿美元（现汇率约合 13.66 亿元人民币）收入。
排名第三的是《生化危机：安魂曲》，预计为 Valve 贡献了约 2.009 亿美元（现汇率约合 13.5 亿元人民币）收入。
Alinea Analytics 分析师 Rhys Elliott 表示，Steam 今年收入最高的前六款新作，合计仅为 Valve 带来了约 10 亿美元（现汇率约合 67.19 亿元人民币）收入，只占 Steam 今年截至目前 150 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,007.91 亿元人民币）总收入的 6.6%。
值得一提的是，收入最高的前六款新作中，有两款属于全新 IP，分别是《红色沙漠》和《Meccha Chameleon》。
如果将统计范围扩大至 2026 年 Steam 收入最高的前 100 款新游戏，其总收入将达到 24 亿美元（现汇率约合 161.27 亿元人民币），占 Steam 今年总收入的 15.9%。
不过，这些数据在一定程度上受到《红色沙漠》的影响。由于这款游戏表现极为出色，其单独就贡献了新 IP 游戏收入中的 18%，约为 2.03 亿美元（现汇率约合 13.64 亿元人民币）。
如果将《红色沙漠》排除在外，新 IP 在相关收入中的占比将从 63% 降至 39%。
当然，2026 年还有不少备受期待的大作尚未推出。就在上周，《鬼武者：剑之道》和《黎明行者之血》两款热门作品正式发售。
今年晚些时候，《战争机器：E-Day》《使命召唤：现代战争 4》以及《影之刃零》等游戏也将陆续推出。

title: 售价 29.99 万元、自带原生电动升降顶，小米澎程 N90 Max 探索版正式发布
content:
感谢IT之家网友
Autumn_Dream
偏科骚黄4100只眼
9 月 7 日消息，在今晚的小米秋季旗舰新品发布会上，小米澎程 N90 Max 探索版正式发布，自带原生电动升降顶，采用大五座布局，售价 29.99 万元。
IT之家注意到，作为探索版最核心的创新，小米澎程 N90 Max 探索版配备了原生电动升降顶舱系统。一键启动后，车顶自动升起，车内秒变上下两层 LOFT 结构，二层形成独立的通透活动空间，可用面积达 2110mm×985mm，最大承重 200kg。配合车内空间优化，整车挑高可达 2294mm，用户可在车内完全站立，实现“站着换衣服、伸懒腰、边走边思考”的居家体验。
该顶舱采用车身同色设计，闭合状态下车高仅增加 100mm，风阻系数控制在 0.245。车顶升起后，二层配备五面纱窗，采光面积达 1.7㎡，并集成独立照明、双空调出风口、18W Type-C 充电口及磁吸拓展点位，兼顾视野通透性与功能完备性。
针对升降顶舱的安全性，小米原生设计了 19 项专项安全防护机制，涵盖升顶行车限制、儿童密码锁、运行提示音、床板状态检测、降雨 / 锁车未关提醒、地库限高识别、雷达防撞及降顶智能检测等功能。结构方面，顶舱底部加强框采用先进高强钢，整车通过 44.7km/h 翻滚试验，确保升降顶舱无脱落、无明显变形。耐久性方面，车顶完成 1 万次循环开闭测试，配合 1.2 万次踩踏测试，功能无异常。
需要强调的是，出于公共道路安全考虑，该升降顶功能仅限在非公共道路且驻车状态下使用，系统配备地库限高障碍提醒功能，通过前后激光雷达与车顶超声波雷达融合感知，降低刮顶与磕顶风险。
车内空间布局是探索版的另一大亮点。二排配备经典方格绗缝工艺沙发座椅，支持一键快速成床（可通过小爱同学语音操控），形成 1.87m×1.24m 的纯平大床，并标配通风与加热功能。二排座椅支持四六分折，可单独成床，满足多样化场景需求。
在舒适性配置上，新车搭载舒享地暖系统，采用航空级柔性发热膜，三挡加热可调，地板最高温度可达 38°C，在 0°C 环境下 10 分钟内地板表面最高可升温至 25°C。配合方向盘加热、全车座椅加热、热泵空调及压缩机冰箱制热功能，构建完整的冬季温暖体验。
内饰细节方面，车辆配备悬浮式床头柜（集成 220V/12V 双电源、磁吸点位与床头灯）、总容量 20L 的嵌入式壁橱，以及 11.5 英寸柔光化妆镜（4000K 自然日光色温，115° 任意角度悬停）。全车铺设 1.7㎡ 原生木纹铝合金地板，采用 9 层喷涂与 7 层复合结构，兼具真实触感与优异抗弯折性能。
娱乐系统方面，小米澎程 N90 Max 探索版搭载 30 英寸巨幕投影系统，支持 1080P 高清显示与 650 流明亮度，幕布 25 秒快速升降，可通过遥控或语音控制，最远视距达 1096mm，并内置海量儿童内容资源。
在户外场景下，车辆定位为“露营神车”，配合电动顶舱、外放电及丰富的车内起居功能，实现从交通工具到移动居所的跨越。
探索版在基础配置上同样保持高规格，全系标配 21 英寸轮毂与普利司通静音轮胎、空气弹簧 + 连续阻尼可变减振器、前双叉臂 + 后多连杆独立悬架、博世 ESP 10.0 车身稳定系统、博世 DPB 智能制动助力器。智能驾驶方面配备双激光雷达、4D 毫米波雷达及 4nm 旗舰芯片。被动安全方面，车辆采用铠甲笼式车身，16 处应用 2200MPa 超高强度钢，配备 9 个安全气囊、内嵌式防滚架、一体式热成型门环及门把手三重冗余设计。此外，智能电动门、滑动中岛、一排旋转座椅、压缩机冰箱及小米星弦豪华音响（25 扬声器）均为标配。

小米中折叠手机 + 澎程系列 SUV，小米“双王牌”到齐！今晚（9 月 7 日）19:00，小米秋季旗舰新品发布会准时开启。
小米不仅发布了 18 Fold 手机和 9 Pro Max 平板，还正式推出澎程家族力作 N90 Max、N70 Max、N70 Pro，更带来了 One more thing。
手机、汽车，双双都是万众瞩目的焦点新品，小米这次亮出的“双王牌”到底有多能打？IT之家小编这就为大家盘一盘。
一、小米 18 Fold
咱们先聚焦于小米的折叠屏手机，雷军表示，小米做折叠屏手机已经有五六年的历史，已推出四款大折叠、两款小折叠。
这几年小米一直在思考一个问题，结合小折叠与大折叠优势，能不能做一款尺寸更合适、比例更舒服、更多人喜欢的新形态呢，小米的答案是“中折叠”。
小米 18 Fold 在两年前立项，研发了 20 个月，是小米迄今为止最高端手机。
具体来看，屏幕方面，小米 18 Fold 配备 5.38 英寸外屏 +7.58 英寸内屏，内外屏采用约√2:1 标准纸张比例。
雷军称，这个比例恰到好处。用来阅读，如看书般自然；用来观影，画面铺展不用裁切；办公看文档，无需缩放调整，内容一目了然。
两块屏幕均为超级像素屏，支持 LTPO 1-120Hz 刷新率、4000nits 超级阳光屏 (APL 30%)。
配色方面，除了主打的“西野红”，还有暖金白、黑色两款颜色。
设计方面，小米 18 Fold 展开厚度为 5.02mm，闭合厚度为 10.68mm，整机重量为 219g，配备超椭圆大 R 角、纯平包裹式中框、跑道型 DECO。
外屏单手操控可覆盖大部分区域，单行显示字数更多，符合人眼横向阅读习惯。此外，键盘比 6.9 英寸直板机宽 8%。
展开高度为 117.8mm，展开宽度为 163.8mm，展开厚度为 5.02mm，支持全新多任务模式，至高支持六分屏，搭配“超级小爱灵感球”，复杂操作一键即达。
转轴方面，小米 18 Fold 搭载新一代小米龙骨转轴，采用三级连杆结构、自然水滴形态，支持转轴全贴合保护。
使用高强度机身材料，包括 7 系铝合金中框、小米龙晶玻璃 3.0，同时外屏还进行了离子注入强化。
创新采用双层 UTG 超薄玻璃、有机柔性绝缘材料，尖锐物品抗冲击性较上代提升 258%、钢球重物跌落高度较上代提升 214%，整机跌落高度达到 1.2m，平均折痕深度≤30µm。
性能方面，小米 18 Fold 首发搭载玄戒 O3 小米 AI 旗舰 SoC，这也是首款超 500 万分的 AI 旗舰 SoC。
CPU 多核性能提升 60%，中低负载功耗降低 25%；GPU 性能提升 85%，功耗降低 64%；NPU Tensor 算力 200TOPS，Vector 算力 3.13TFLOPS。
此外，小米联合长鑫存储率先量产国产 LPDDR6。
续航方面，内置 6000mAh 小米金沙江电池，采用双叠片电池，拥有 20% 高含硅量、920Wh/L 能量密度，支持 67W 有线秒充、50W 无线秒充。
影像方面，搭载全焦段徕卡超清三摄，包括徕卡 2 亿主摄、5000 万像素 3.5x 徕卡潜望长焦、5000 万像素徕卡超广角。
另外还有一个陶瓷特别版，使用新型氮化硅陶瓷，重量更轻、硬度更高。
- 12GB+256GB 售价 10999 元；
- 12GB+512GB 售价 11999 元；
- 16GB+512GB 售价 12999 元；
- 16GB+1TB LPDDR6 售价 14999 元；
- 16GB+1TB LPDDR6 陶瓷特别版售价 15999 元。
二、小米平板 9 Pro Max
紧跟小米 18 Fold，小米平板 9 Pro Max 随即登场，同样首发玄戒 O3 芯片。
来看重点规格，小米平板 9 Pro Max 搭载了一块 13.3 英寸高清原色屏，144Hz 刷新率，3.4K 分辨率；3:2 屏幕比例、适配 PC 级应用界面；全局亮度 1000nits、ΔE≈0.47，可选纳米柔光屏版。
采用金属一体化机身设计，配备简约 Deco、跑道型设计、XRING 徽标，可选浓郁酒红、黑色、银色三种颜色。
厚度为 5.67mm、整机重 645g，电池容量 12000mAh，支持 120W 小米澎湃秒充。
首发搭载玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰处理器，CPU 多核、GPU 跑分逼近苹果 M5。
搭载 6 麦克风阵列和旗舰 8 扬声器，采用 32MP+50MP 超清前后摄，支持 Wi-Fi 7 高速连接。
首发小米澎湃 OS 4，专为大屏生产力构建；支持多分屏模式，至高支持 6 分屏；双分屏，自由调节显示比例；三分屏，一屏三应用并行；六分屏，复杂任务，全景处理。
支持 DP-in 音视频输入，通过全功能 Type-C 直连，可变便携显示器，可做电脑副屏、专业数位屏、游戏大屏。
- 8GB+256GB 售价 4799 元
- 12GB+256GB 售价 5299 元
- 16GB+256GB 售价 5799 元
- 12GB+512GB 售价 6099 元
- 16GB+512GB 售价 6599 元
- 16GB+512GB 柔光屏版售价 6899 元
- 16GB+1TB 柔光屏版售价 7899 元
- 悬浮键盘售价 1099 元
三、澎程 N70 Pro
看完小米的新手机和新平板，该把目光投向汽车了。
还记得 7 月 30 日的技术发布会上，雷军主要讲了 N90 Max，N70 只是顺带一提；但到了今天，N70 成了重点介绍的焦点。
小米澎程 N70 定位“中大型五座增程 SUV”，拥有经典豪华 SUV 车身比例：车长 4960mm、宽 1998mm、轴距 2950mm。
集延续蜻蜓大灯、光环尾灯、无边框后视镜、鹅卵石激光雷达等家族化设计语言于一身。
车身颜色共有 6 款，分别为蝴蝶谷蓝、远山青、珍珠白、火山灰、曜石黑、冷卡其。
看完外在看内在，澎程 N70 提供砂陶米、摩卡棕、暗夜黑 3 款内饰颜色。
全车 6.14㎡防晒玻璃，天幕搭配全遮光物理遮阳帘；全车高频接触面 95% 软包覆，婴幼儿可直接皮肤接触；还有双拼色方向盘、立柜式中控台、电镀门把手等更多细节。
空间方面，澎程 N70 不同于传统五座 SUV 二排几乎不可移动，基于小米昆仑技术架构能实现智能可变空间。
一排标配按摩座椅，标配滑动中岛；二排采用电动座椅，提供最大 135 度躺倒角度，二排乘坐空间 1010mm，头部空间 1021mm，二排座椅极致后移后最大乘坐空间 1410mm。
后备厢标准容积 1203L，二排放倒后车后提供 2425L 空间；支持对坐模式，双人对坐最大空间 1687mm；后车门支持近 90 度开合，可选电动迎宾踏板。
后排提供 21.4 英寸 3K 分辨率面板，配 14 扬声器高级音响系统。
智能方面，澎程 N70 搭载第三代骁龙 8 移动平台、NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor 700TOPS 辅助驾驶算力芯片，带有 12 颗超声波雷达，标配小米 HAD 辅助驾驶。
搭载小米澎湃智能座舱；域控制模块四合一，车机流畅，响应迅速；超级小爱深度语言控车，车内、车外都能控；人车家全生态互联，兼容苹果生态。
驾驶方面，澎程 N70 Pro 峰值功率 210kW，0-100km/h 加速 7.9s，最高时速 190km/h，转弯半径 5.67m，搭载 52kWh 磷酸铁锂小米龙甲电池，CLTC 纯电续航 351 km，CLTC 综合续航 1351km。
使用小米昆仑增程器 1.5T，支持 92# 汽油，WLTC 亏电油耗 Pro 5.7L/100km，增程器官方首保后 3 年或增程器 3 万公里保养一次。
安全方面，澎程 N70 标配 14 处 2200MPa 小米超强钢、2200MPa「内嵌式防滚架」、一体式热成型门环、一体式热成型前地板骨架、9 个安全气囊、门把手三重冗余设计、尾门双应急拉手、低速慢行灯，支持 160km/h 爆胎稳定控制、650mm 最高涉水能力、应急浮水脱困功能等。
价格方面，澎程 N70 Pro 售价 20.99 万元，首销期间赠前排免费选装座椅、8000 元轮毂选装券和 3000 元车漆选装券。
四、澎程 N70 Max
Pro 之上还有 Max，澎程 N70 Max 同步正式上市，定价 23.99 万元起。
从 Pro 到 Max，最显著的区别在于动力和底盘相关的规格，澎湃 N70 Max 采用双电机四驱设计，最大功率 310kW、零百加速 5.5s、最高时速 190km/h，标配前双叉臂、后 H 臂多连杆悬架；标配空气弹簧、连续阻尼可变减振器；转弯半径 5.67m，宣称三车道一把过。
搭载 76kWh 大电池、45L 油箱、小米昆仑增程器 1.5T，CLTC 纯电续航达 505km、CLTC 综合续航达到 1461km，WLTC 亏电油耗 6.1L/100km，92# 95# 98#汽油多油品适配。
另外，新车增程器首保后，3 年或增程器 3 万公里保养一次。
值得一提的是，雷军强调作为一家北方车厂，小米一直有一个明确的目标：希望把增程车的冬季体验，做到行业最好。
为此，小米把积累多年的纯电车热管理技术，完整迁移到增程车上。在低温环境下，小米澎程系列的纯电续航保持率高达 66%；环境温度-40℃ 时，仍能一键冷启动。
另外，像激光雷达、辅助驾驶、4D 毫米波雷达、NVIDIA Thor 芯片、Xiaomi HAD 辅助驾驶、小米 XLA 认知大模型，统统都是标配。
五、澎程 N90 Max
看完了澎程 N70 的两款车型，是时候锁定 N90 Max 了，该车大七座旗舰增程 SUV，长宽高分别为 5285/1998/1825mm，轴距 3080mm。
不仅可选酒红等 7 种外观颜色和砂陶米等 3 款内饰以及个性化饰板，还标配 21 英寸棱镜轮毂，普利司通静音轮胎。
作为新一代“陆地公务舱”，采用 2+2+3 式布局，第三排成年人乘坐也不拥挤；一二排标配 16 点式座椅按摩，全车最多可选 4 个零重力座椅，一排可选标准按摩座椅 / 旋转座椅（带按摩功能）/零重力座椅，还可选智能电动门。
一排座椅支持电动旋转（支持小爱同学控制），在“对坐模式”下双人乘坐空间最大 1760mm、四人模式二排空间 1370mm，二三排极致后移，空间最大 1550mm，后备厢容积可达 1831 升。
后排配备 3K 分辨率 21.4 英寸后排娱乐屏，支持海量儿童内容。中岛内置两个手机位、四个杯托、6.6L 容量、9L 独立压缩机冰箱，可滑动到第二排座位作为“多功能茶几”使用。全车提供 17 个空调出风口，配备 4890W 峰值功率 25 扬声器 7.1.4 声学架构音箱系统。
搭载双电机四驱，峰值功率 310kW，最高时速 190km/h，采用搭载前双叉臂 + 后多连杆独立悬架。
采用大电池增程，CLTC 纯电续航 464km，CLTC 综合续航 1705km，WLTC 亏电油耗 6.26L/100km。
搭载小米澎湃智能座舱，超级小爱语音交互，实现全场景互联互通，支持双 5G 双卡双通、Wi-Fi 7、IoT 通讯接口、内置 ETC 可免费激活。
满配辅助驾驶，标配前向激光雷达、后向固态激光雷达、700TOPS NVIDIA Thor™芯片。
搭载铠甲笼式车身、一体式热成型门环，16 处关键位置采用 2200MPa 超强钢，配备 12 个安全气囊，每个座位更安全。
三重安全冗余门把手、750mm 最高涉水能力、160km/h 高速爆胎稳定控制。
价格方面，澎程 N90 Max 售价 26.99 万元，10 月 7 日 24 时之前下定，前排旋转座椅、Nappa 真皮、8000 元轮毂选装券、3000 元车漆选装券免费送、二排双零重力座椅免费送，价值 2.6 万元的小米 HAD 辅助驾驶终身免费使用。
同时可选豪华套装，包含智能电动门、后排娱乐屏、电动迎宾踏板、车载 9L 压缩机冰箱、麂皮绒车顶、主驾外后视镜防眩目，定价 3.1 万元，限时优惠价 2 万元。
六、澎程 N90 Max 探索版
在澎程 N90 Max 正式发布后，雷军带来了 One more thing —— 澎程 N90 Max 探索版。
“探索版”的核心，在于配备了原生电动升降顶舱系统。一键启动后，车顶自动升起，车内秒变上下两层 LOFT 结构，二层形成独立的通透活动空间，可用面积达 2110mm×985mm，最大承重 200kg。配合车内空间优化，整车挑高可达 2294mm，用户可在车内完全站立。
雷军表示，这个升降顶舱年检不用拆下来，因为是原生的升降顶舱，和整车融为一体；但他也提醒，升降顶舱需要在非公共道路上、驻车场景下使用，也不建议在恶劣天气下使用。
顶舱采用车身同色设计，闭合状态下车高仅增加 100mm，风阻系数控制在 0.245。车顶升起后，二层配备五面纱窗，采光面积达 1.7㎡，并集成独立照明、双空调出风口、18W Type-C 充电口及磁吸拓展点位，兼顾视野通透性与功能完备性。
针对升降顶舱的安全性，小米原生设计了 19 项专项安全防护机制，顶舱底部加强框采用先进高强钢，整车通过 44.7km/h 翻滚试验，确保升降顶舱无脱落、无明显变形。耐久性方面，车顶完成 1 万次循环开闭测试，配合 1.2 万次踩踏测试，功能无异常。
车内空间布局是探索版的另一大亮点。二排配备经典方格绗缝工艺沙发座椅，支持一键快速成床，形成 1.87m×1.24m 的纯平大床，并标配通风与加热功能。二排座椅支持四六分折，可单独成床，满足多样化场景需求。
在舒适性配置上，新车搭载舒享地暖系统，采用航空级柔性发热膜，三挡加热可调，地板最高温度可达 38°C，在 0°C 环境下 10 分钟内地板表面最高可升温至 25°C。配合方向盘加热、全车座椅加热、热泵空调及压缩机冰箱制热功能，构建完整的冬季温暖体验。
内饰细节方面，车辆配备悬浮式床头柜（集成 220V/12V 双电源、磁吸点位与床头灯）、总容量 20L 的嵌入式壁橱，以及 11.5 英寸柔光化妆镜（4000K 自然日光色温，115° 任意角度悬停）。
全车铺设 1.7㎡ 原生木纹铝合金地板，采用 9 层喷涂与 7 层复合结构，兼具真实触感与优异抗弯折性能。
娱乐系统方面，搭载 30 英寸巨幕投影系统，支持 1080P 高清显示与 650 流明亮度，幕布 25 秒快速升降，可通过遥控或语音控制，最远视距达 1096mm，并内置海量儿童内容资源。
在户外场景下，车辆定位为“露营神车”，配合电动顶舱、外放电及丰富的车内起居功能，实现从交通工具到移动居所的跨越。
至于其它的规格，澎程 N90 Max 探索版基本和 N90 Max 看齐，售价 29.99 万元。
关于小米秋季旗舰新品发布会的情况，IT之家小编就盘到这里。
从 18 Fold 到平板 9 Pro Max 再到澎程新车的定价，大家这波是否愿意喊一声“雷神”？
需要注意的是，在本月底，小米还有一场发布会，届时迎面走来的将会是 18 Pro 系列等新品，敬请期待！

title: 广汽集团称坚决不造“速成车”：不赶工期、不压验证，每一辆车都要经得起时间考验
content:
9 月 7 日消息，广汽集团今晚发文，称
坚决不造“速成车”，只下“笨功夫”
—— 不赶工期，不压验证，每一辆车都要经得起时间考验。
广汽集团表示，新车开发严格恪守“
”验证周期，更采用远超行业的“
”极限测试标准 —— 在高寒、高温、高海拔三高试验基础上，进一步扩展高湿、高腐蚀、复杂山路及沙尘环境试验，覆盖 -40℃ 极寒、60℃ 极热、4000 米以上高海拔、沿海高盐雾、山区崎岖路况及沙漠风沙等全环境。

title: 消息称三星进入人形机器人赛道，计划在明年 CES 2027 首秀
content:
感谢IT之家网友
9 月 7 日消息，据韩媒 sedaily 消息，三星电子正加快其人形机器人原型机的研发，计划在明年 1 月于美国拉斯维加斯举办的 CES 2027 上，
首次公开其自主研发的人形机器人
业内消息称，在三星电子 DX 部门负责人卢泰文（Roh Tae-moon）的直属管辖下，三星机器人 RX 部门正主导筹备将于明年 CES 登场的样机。业内高层人士表示：“随着人工智能技术的持续演进，人形机器人的商业化落地节点有望大幅提前，三星电子正因此全面提速。”
据悉，三星 DX 部门首席技术官兼总裁尹长贤（Janghyun Yoon）目前正同时挂帅机器人 RX 部门旗下的硬件与人工智能软件两大研发团队，全力推进产品迭代。报道称，在业内由单一核心高管统筹掌管负责机械驱动的硬件团队与负责感知决策的 AI 软件团队，极为罕见。
三星内部与业界普遍认为，在研发初期便将掌管机器人“AI 软件大脑”与“硬件本体”的技术负责人合二为一，是
三星意在全面压缩研发周期
的战略布局。究其原因，若继续沿用软硬件分别独立研发再行拼装的传统模式，将根本无法跟上当前人工智能技术的指数级演进速度。
IT之家获悉，为加速人形机器人的商业化落地，三星电子已密集布局并锁定了多项核心专利，涵盖人形机器人运动骨架核心的髋关节设计技术、下一代高灵巧度机械手，以及基于 AI 的运动控制技术。

title: 联发科技带来曦力 G99+ 移动平台，支持 5500Mbps LPDDR5X 内存
content:

曦力 4G 处理器主要面向对性能不敏感而对成本敏感的市场。主要 DRAM 内存原厂的产能布局正转向 HBM、LPDDR5X、DDR5，老旧制程工艺产线面临关停或升级，导致 LPDDR4X 供给能力严重下滑，其价格随之飙升。
G99+ 提供对 LPDDR5X 的支持可提升下游智能手机制造商的灵活性，根据内存物料价格情况灵活调整产品结构，始终维持最低成本。

„Gravitationswellen sind unsichtbar und gleichzeitig können wir damit in die Zeit zurückblicken, in der es noch gar kein Licht im Universum gab“, erklärt Prof. Dr. Ingo Elsen. Er ist Professor am Fachbereich Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik der FH Aachen und leitet dort das Big Data Lab. Im Herbst startet sein dreijähriges Forschungsprojekt, in dem er mit seinem Team einen Baustein für das geplante Einstein-Teleskop entwickeln möchte. KI und Rauschkompensation lauten hierbei die Schlüsselbegriffe.
In den kommenden Jahren soll in Europa – möglicherweise sogar in der Euregio Maas-Rhein – das sogenannte Einstein-Teleskop gebaut werden. „Bei dem Wort ‚Teleskop‘ denkt man natürlich erst einmal an ein Fernrohr. Das Einstein-Teleskop funktioniert aber völlig anders“, so Prof. Elsen. Im Gegensatz zu einem gewöhnlichen Teleskop werden die Forschenden mit dem Einstein-Teleskop nicht direkt ins All schauen, sondern sogenannte Gravitationswellen messen, die aus dem All auf die Erde treffen. Diese Gravitationswellen sind, vereinfacht gesagt, Erschütterungen in Raum und Zeit. Sie entstehen beispielsweise, wenn zwei Schwarze Löcher oder zwei Neutronensterne miteinander verschmelzen. Die Forschenden können mit der Untersuchung der Gravitationswellen mehr über die Entstehung und Entwicklung unseres Universums erfahren. „Das ist Science-Fiction ohne Fiction. Ich bin total begeistert“, sagt der Professor.
Das Observatorium wird wie ein gleichseitiges Dreieck aufgebaut sein und rund 300 Meter unter der Erdoberfläche liegen. „Das Einstein-Teleskop dürfte nach dem CERN die zweitgrößte Maschine der Welt werden“, so Prof. Elsen. Jede seiner drei Seiten wird ein zehn Kilometer langer Tunnel sein, in dem mithilfe von Lasern und Spiegeln die Tunnellängen gemessen werden. Wenn sich die gemessene Länge minimal in einem bestimmten Muster ändert, wissen die Forschenden, dass die Ursache eine vorbeiziehende Gravitationswelle gewesen sein muss. Diese Art des unterirdischen Observatoriums ist nicht neu. Es gibt bereits vergleichbare Teleskope, aber in kleinerem Maßstab. Das Einstein-Teleskop wird also deutlich empfindlicher sein und präzisere Daten liefern können.
Ein Problem gibt es allerdings: Unsere Welt ist ziemlich laut. Erdbeben, fahrende Lkw oder rotierende Windräder geben Vibrationen ab, die sich mit den Gravitationswellen-Signalen mischen, sodass diese nur mit deutlichen Störungen aufgezeichnet werden können – auch 300 Meter unter der Erde. Diese irdischen Störsignale werden als „Newtonsches Rauschen“ bezeichnet. Prof. Elsen möchte mit seinem Team ein KI-Modell entwickeln, durch das die Störungen in Echtzeit herausgefiltert werden können. „Die Wirkung kann man sich vorstellen wie bei Noise-Cancelling-Kopfhörern. Störende Hintergrundvibrationen werden live herausgefiltert und es bleibt das übrig, was man wirklich haben möchte“, beschreibt Prof. Elsen. So könnten potenziell wichtige Signale direkt erkannt und abgespeichert werden. Alle uninteressanten Signale müssten dann nicht erst mühsam kontrolliert und aussortiert werden, während sie gleichzeitig große Mengen an Speicherkapazität belegen. Die Forschenden des Einstein-Teleskops könnten direkt mit der Auswertung der gefilterten Signale starten.
Das Newtonsche Rauschen sei jedoch nicht so vorhersehbar wie die Umgebungsgeräusche, die ein Kopfhörer filtern muss. Das Herausrechnen des Rauschens mittels klassischer mathematischer Signalverarbeitungsmethoden werde deshalb für das Forschungsvorhaben nicht mehr ausreichen. Es brauche stattdessen spezielle Hardware und moderne datenbasierte KI-Methoden, um eine Rauschkompensation in Echtzeit zu leisten. „Klassische KI-Rechner, wie sie momentan überall für KI-Sprachmodelle errichtet werden, sind nicht schnell genug“, so Prof. Elsen. Stattdessen sollen sogenannte Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) den Mittelpunkt der Hardware darstellen. Dabei handelt es sich um Computerchips, die für spezifische Aufgaben programmiert werden können. Das Herzstück, sprich das KI-Modell zur Rauschreduktion, soll auf die FPGA eingearbeitet werden. „Sprachmodelle sind in den letzten Jahren besser geworden, weil sie größer geworden sind. Wir müssen für unser Ziel nun gute, aber möglichst kompakte Modelle entwickeln, damit eine Datenverarbeitung in Echtzeit möglich wird“, sagt Prof. Elsen.
Ein solches KI-Modell könnte auch in der Industrie wichtige Innovationen anstoßen. Es wäre laut Prof. Elsen beispielsweise denkbar, das KI-Modell auf die Stoßdämpfer eines Autos anzuwenden: „Sofort würden alle Unebenheiten der Straße herausgerechnet und es würde sich anfühlen, als gleite man auf einer Eisfläche dahin.“ Auch in der Medizintechnik könnte eine solche Anwendung wertvoll sein. Wenn die Vibrationen bei einer Operation am Knochen in Echtzeit reduziert werden könnten, würde das das Bruch- und Splitterrisiko für die Patienten senken.
Für das Forschungsprojekt konnte Prof. Elsen auch einen Studierenden begeistern. Jan Pihl beendet derzeit seinen Master in Informatik an der FH Aachen und wird in dem Forschungsprojekt als Doktorand arbeiten. In einem Modul von Prof. Elsen hat er sich bereits mit den Daten von Gravitationswellen beschäftigt und konnte die Ergebnisse gemeinsam mit einem Kommilitonen beim Einsteinsymposium vorstellen. Als weitere Kooperationspartner:innen sind die RWTH Aachen, das Forschungszentrum Jülich sowie die Universität Siegen an dem Forschungsprojekt beteiligt. Das Einstein-Teleskop befindet sich derzeit in der Planungsphase. Im kommenden Jahr soll die Standortfrage final beantwortet werden; der Bau soll bis 2035 größtenteils abgeschlossen werden. „Ich bin wirklich stolz, dass wir bei diesem riesigen Projekt mitwirken dürfen. Ohne all die helfenden Hände meiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Forschung und Verwaltung wären wir heute nicht da, wo wir sind. Dafür bin ich sehr dankbar und freue mich auf die weitere Reise.“
